news.name: Giants Stun Cowboys 28-20 in Harbaugh's Winning Debut with Nabers' Return
news.summary: The Giants dominated the second half, holding the ball for over 36 minutes and converting nine of 11 third downs to beat the Cowboys 28-20 in their season opener at MetLife Stadium. Jaxson Dart threw three touchdown passes and ran for 54 yards, while Isaiah Likely caught two scores and Cam Skattebo added 81 rushing yards and a touchdown. Nabers caught six passes for 69 yards in his emotional comeback, boosted by Harbaugh's hands-on encouragement, as Dallas managed just two second-half possessions.

news.hook: New York football fans finally have a reason to smile after both the Giants and Jets kicked off the season with wins – a rare sweep not seen in 17 years.
news.name: Giants and Jets Both Start 2026 NFL Season 1-0 for First Time Since 2009
news.summary: The Jets beat the Titans 23-10, with coach Aaron Glenn firing up the locker room by shouting, “Who wanna fly with them fuin Jets?” The Giants followed with a 28-20 victory over the Cowboys in John Harbaugh’s debut at MetLife Stadium. Both teams now lead their divisions, sparking memes and excitement across the city, with odds at +168 for the Giants and +520 for the Jets.

news.hook: Carrie Underwood belted out a fresh rock-infused 'Waiting All Day for Sunday Night' as the Giants hosted the Cowboys, sending fans into cheers with her high-energy performance.
news.name: Carrie Underwood Revamps Sunday Night Football Anthem for 2026 Kickoff
news.summary: Underwood returned for her 14th year opening NBC's primetime broadcast, reworking Joan Jett's 'I Hate Myself for Loving You' in settings from a recording studio to a packed stadium. Fans shared game-day tattoos, echoed the anthem's lyrics, and hailed her as the 'Queen of Sunday Night Football' amid the Week 1 NFC East clash at MetLife Stadium. Creative director Tripp Dixon praised blending her rock past and present, while Underwood called it one of her favorites in her rock star journey.

news.hook: John Harbaugh tackled receiver Malik Nabers during walkthroughs to build his confidence. 'Never had this before. That’s love coach❤️,' Nabers later said of the hands-on moment.
news.name: Giants Top Cowboys 28-20 in Harbaugh's Debut Win
news.summary: The New York Giants opened the 2026 NFL season with a 28-20 victory over the Dallas Cowboys at MetLife Stadium, marking John Harbaugh's debut as head coach. Second-year quarterback Jaxson Dart shone, completing 23 of 29 passes for 230 yards and three touchdowns, while adding 54 rushing yards with no picks. Tight end Isaiah Likely caught all eight targets for 78 yards and two scores, and the Giants converted nine of 11 third downs to control the game. Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott threw for 175 yards and two touchdowns but had an interception in the loss.

news.hook: Isaiah Likely hauled in eight catches for 78 yards and two touchdowns against the Cowboys, giving former Ravens fans a bittersweet glimpse of what might have been.
news.name: Isaiah Likely Shines in Giants Debut, Stirs Ravens Fans
news.summary: The 26-year-old tight end, who signed a three-year, $40 million deal with the Giants in March to reunite with coach John Harbaugh, outshone ex-teammate Mark Andrews in their openers—Likely scoring twice in New York's 28-20 win, while Andrews managed 49 yards without a touchdown in Baltimore's 41-23 rout of the Colts. Ravens supporters shared heartfelt posts, with one saying he's 'the only former Raven I’mma truly miss' and others lamenting the choice to extend Andrews instead. Some countered that Baltimore offered Likely bigger deals, but he left for a starring role; the split highlights how backups often thrive elsewhere in the NFL.

news.hook: Jaxson Dart stepped up in his first start, firing three touchdown passes as the Giants controlled the clock and stunned their rivals at MetLife Stadium.
news.name: Giants Kick Off Harbaugh Era with 28-20 Win Over Cowboys
news.summary: New coach John Harbaugh got a statement victory in his Giants debut, beating the Cowboys 28-20 on Sunday Night Football. Rookie QB Jaxson Dart shone with 230 passing yards, three TDs, and 59 rushing yards, while tight end Isaiah Likely grabbed two scores in his first game. Malik Nabers returned strong from a torn ACL, catching six passes for 69 yards, and teammates handed him the game ball in celebration. The defense limited Dallas to 69 rushing yards, fitting Harbaugh's physical style perfectly.

news.hook: Bills fans cheered Josh Allen's fist pump after their 36-31 win, kicking off a wave of Victory Monday joy across the league.
news.name: NFL Fans Celebrate Victory Monday After Wild Week 1 Wins
news.summary: Winning teams like the Buffalo Bills, Jacksonville Jaguars, and Chicago Bears lit up the first week with high-scoring victories, including the Bears' record 59-37 rout of the Panthers—the highest-scoring Week 1 game ever. Fans extended the excitement into Monday with team gear, memes, tailgates, and posts like 'DA BEARS! Victory Monday!!!' Even some losing fans nodded along with 'Happy Victory Monday to those that can celebrate.' The tradition lets victors savor Sunday triumphs before the next matchup.

news.hook: The MetLife Stadium crowd erupted as Odell Beckham Jr. walked out first in his No. 13 jersey, eight years after his last Giants game, blonde hair and all for that throwback feel.
news.name: Odell Beckham Jr. Returns to Giants with Ovation and One-Handed Catch
news.summary: Beckham reunited with Victor Cruz on the field and made an insane one-handed catch to thrill fans during the season opener against the Dallas Cowboys. Young stars like Cam Skattebo celebrated a touchdown with a backflip, while second-year players Jaxson Dart and Abdul Carter showed sharper confidence in throwback jerseys. Under new coach John Harbaugh, OBJ aimed to prove who he is now, blending nostalgia with the team's fresh energy in the divisional rivalry.
